sentences.en: She orientated herself in the new city by using her smartphone.
sentences.zh: 她通过手机在新城市里让自己适应了环境。

sentences.en: The company orientates its employees to the corporate culture on their first day.
sentences.zh: 公司在员工第一天上班时就使他们熟悉公司的文化。

sentences.en: The room was orientated to face south for better sunlight exposure.
sentences.zh: 这个房间朝南以获得更好的阳光照射。
